responsibility: This implementation module provides the Logitech-compatible millisecond delay primitive by delegating to the Selective wrapper around select-style timeout handling. It constructs a Timeval, waits with no file descriptors, and releases the temporary time object, making it a small runtime timing adapter rather than a date/time conversion module.
same_name_distinction: Implementation half of the Delay pair: it realizes Delay by building a Selective.Timeval and calling Select with no file descriptors, whereas Delay.def only declares the procedure.
